text: Final categorization: POSSIBLE (Justification: The paper is a non-review research article that develops an integrated model linking economic activity, greenhouse gas emissions, biodiversity, and agricultural production. While it incorporates land use as a key variable and projects future land use changes to 2050 at a country level (national-scale implementation across 239 countries), LULC prediction is not the primary objective. Instead, land use patterns are used as inputs to assess impacts on biodiversity and productivity. The model uses future scenarios and includes quantitative projections of land use change (e.g., expansion of agricultural/built land from ~50% to ~60% of terrestrial area), but it does not focus on simulating or predicting LULC dynamics per se, nor does it report spatial accuracy metrics for LULC projections. Thus, LULC prediction serves as an intermediate step rather than the central research question.)
